example.title: Abram Click farmstead, granary and machinery

brief: Long low gable-roofed frame granary and implement shed, about 24 ft by 44 ft, in faded barn-red vertical boards weathered to grey at the base, with a sagging wood-shingle roof gone silver and patchy with missing shingles. A small ventilator opening in the gable. Around it sits a row of retired machinery: a steel threshing separator with its long straw-stacker pipe, iron-wheeled seed drill and a rusty orange tractor, all in unmown grass.
